{"metadata":{"kernelspec":{"display_name":"Python 3","language":"python","name":"python3"},"language_info":{"name":"python","version":"3"}},"nbformat_minor":4,"nbformat":4,"cells":[{"id":"step1010-01","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Mathematical mechanism

Let $T(a)$ be the established reorder operator. Within one invocation, a
proposal is accepted only when its locally evaluated factor margin improves by
more than $0.5$:

$$
\Phi_a(T(a)) > \Phi_a(a) + 0.5.
$$

The anchor $\Phi_a$ can change with the current order, so the finite orbit may
either reach a fixed point $a^*$,

$$
T(a^*)=a^*.
$$

or revisit an earlier ordering. If a cycle begins at index $r$ and has length
$L$, the exact reference phase is selected without replaying the orbit:

$$
a_{41}=a_{r+((41-r)\bmod L)}.
$$

The loop stops at equality, fast-forwards a cycle to that exact reference
phase, or continues an acyclic residual chain up to 48 passes.
","metadata":{}},{"id":"step1010-02","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Safety invariants

The operator preserves all unit commands and all order quantities. A SELL item
is movable only when its total requested quantity is covered by projected
stock and that item is not bought on the same turn. `HIRE`, `BUY_SEED`,
`BUY_ANIMAL`, and `BUY_LAND` keep their relative order and can only move later.
Thus the transformation changes timing, not the selected economic plan.

import ast
import tarfile

with tarfile.open(ARCHIVE, 'r:gz') as bundle:
    assert bundle.getnames() == ['LICENSE.txt', 'NOTICE.txt', 'main.py']
    source = bundle.extractfile('main.py').read()
assert hashlib.sha256(source).hexdigest() == EXPECTED_MAIN_SHA256
compile(source, 'main.py', 'exec')
tree = ast.parse(source, filename='main.py')
assert [node.name for node in tree.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef)][-1] == 'step1010_step1009_fixed_point_agent'
MAIN = OUTPUT_ROOT / 'main.py'
MAIN.write_bytes(source)
assert MAIN.read_bytes() == source
print('main.py:', len(source), 'bytes')
print('main.py SHA-256:', EXPECTED_MAIN_SHA256)
print('READY_TO_SUBMIT')

{"metadata":{"kernelspec":{"display_name":"Python 3","language":"python","name":"python3"},"language_info":{"name":"python","version":"3"}},"nbformat_minor":4,"nbformat":4,"cells":[{"id":"step1010-01","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Mathematical mechanism

Let $T(a)$ be the established reorder operator. Within one invocation, a
proposal is accepted only when its locally evaluated factor margin improves by
more than $0.5$:

$$
\Phi_a(T(a)) > \Phi_a(a) + 0.5.
$$

The anchor $\Phi_a$ can change with the current order, so the finite orbit may
either reach a fixed point $a^*$,

$$
T(a^*)=a^*.
$$

or revisit an earlier ordering. If a cycle begins at index $r$ and has length
$L$, the exact reference phase is selected without replaying the orbit:

$$
a_{41}=a_{r+((41-r)\bmod L)}.
$$

The loop stops at equality, fast-forwards a cycle to that exact reference
phase, or continues an acyclic residual chain up to 48 passes.
","metadata":{}},{"id":"step1010-02","cell_type":"markdown","source":"## Safety invariants

The operator preserves all unit commands and all order quantities. A SELL item
is movable only when its total requested quantity is covered by projected
stock and that item is not bought on the same turn. `HIRE`, `BUY_SEED`,
`BUY_ANIMAL`, and `BUY_LAND` keep their relative order and can only move later.
Thus the transformation changes timing, not the selected economic plan.
